buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: A slight edge to Tiafoe on freshness. Medvedev has logged 40 games across 2 matches in 14 days, Tiafoe only 16 across 1. Over the last 7 days it is 2 matches for Medvedev against 1 for Tiafoe.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Medvedev holds a clear advantage on motivation and pressure. Medvedev is on the way up (+80 Elo over 90 days) while Tiafoe has been sliding (-24). Recent form sits 2 pts below Medvedev's season win rate, against 27 pts below Tiafoe's.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Conditions point fairly clearly to Medvedev. Both rate below their overall level on Indoor Hard, but Medvedev holds up better (-31 Elo against -70 for Tiafoe). Medvedev is the more proven player on Indoor Hard: 75% wins in 12 months against 64% for Tiafoe. Played indoors, so weather is not a factor.
